question_en: (问答题)A company wants to build an ML application. Select and order the correct steps from the following list to develop a well-architected ML workload. Each step should be selected one time.
question_cn: (问答题)某公司希望构建机器学习应用，请从下列选项中选择并排序正确的步骤，以搭建架构良好的机器学习工作负载，每个步骤仅能选择一次。

可选步骤: Define business goal and frame ML problem
明确业务目标并构建机器学习问题框架

answer_en: Step1: Define business goal and frame ML problem; Step2: Develop model; Step3: Deploy model; Step4: Monitor model
answer_cn: 步骤1：明确业务目标并构建机器学习问题框架；步骤2：开发模型；步骤3：部署模型；步骤4：监控模型

question_en: (问答题)A company has developed a large language model (LLM) and wants to make the LLM available to multiple internal teams. The company needs to select the appropriate inference mode for each team Select the correct inference mode from the following list for each use case. Each inference mode should be selected one or more times.
question_cn: (问答题)某公司已开发大语言模型（LLM）并希望向多个内部团队开放使用，需为每个团队选择合适的推理模式。请为以下各场景从列表中选择正确的推理模式，每种推理模式可选择一次或多次。

options_en.场景1: The company's chatbot needs predictions from the LLM to understand users' intent with minimal latency.
options_en.场景2: A data processing job needs to query the LLM to process gigabytes of text files on weekends.
options_en.场景3: The company's engineering team needs to create an API that can process small pieces of text content and provide low-latency predictions.

options_cn.场景1: 公司的聊天机器人需要LLM生成预测结果以理解用户意图，且要求延迟最低
options_cn.场景2: 某数据处理任务需在周末调用LLM处理数GB的文本文件
options_cn.场景3: 公司工程团队需搭建API，用于处理小体量文本内容并提供低延迟预测结果

answer_en: 场景1: Real-time inference; 场景2: Batch transform; 场景3: Real-time inference
answer_cn: 场景1：实时推理；场景2：批量转换；场景3：实时推理

question_en: A music company wants to build a system to search for songs by the meaning of the lyrics. Which solution meets this requirement?

options_en.B: Perform domain adaptation fine-tuning on the existing model.
